title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI Advancements: Grok 4.5 showcases rapid problem-solving by refuting a 30-year-old graph theory conjecture in Slack.
Crypto and Stocks: Crypto exchange BitMEX shuts down all operations, while SpaceX stock hits a post-IPO low under $115.
Autonomous Driving: Tesla Robotaxi clocks 380,000 incident-free miles, contrasting with Waymo's 570,000 daily driverless miles.
Football Highlights: FIFA releases its 2026 World Cup Best XI, and Sergio Ramos poses with two World Cup trophies.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.5 Solves 30-Year Graph Theory Conjecture
items.body: Elon Musk reports that Grok 4.5 (specifically a Slackbot named Capy running on Grok 4.5 Medium) successfully refuted the Graffiti Conjecture 284, a graph theory problem that has been open for approximately 30 years, in under 8 minutes.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.5 Speed and Cost-Effectiveness
items.body: Elon Musk describes Grok 4.5 as a highly fast and cost-effective model that 'gets the job done,' comparing its speed and token-efficiency favorably, though noting it is not quite at Fable's level.

items.title: @scotsrule08: Tesla Robotaxi vs Waymo Miles
items.body: Tesla announced that its Robotaxi traveled over 380,000 miles with zero notable incidents. In response, Spencer pointed out for perspective that Alphabet's Waymo is already averaging approximately 570,000 daily driverless miles.

items.title: @PromptLLM: Perplexity AI Sentiment Shift
items.body: Prompter comments on a dramatic shift in sentiment surrounding AI search engine Perplexity, calling it one of the largest corporate 'falls from grace.'

items.title: @SnazzyLabs: Fable and Codex Subagent Synergy
items.body: Quinn Nelson shares an agent architecture setup using Fable as a supervisor/nanny and Codex 5.6 Sol as a fast execution subagent, highlighting how the strengths of both complementary models are leveraged.

items.title: @gkxspace: Deep Dive Into AI Agents Book Star Surge
items.body: Yu Wen notes that the GitHub repository for the book 'Deep Dive Into AI Agents' gained 17,000 stars in one week, praising its clear engineering-focused explanations of KV Cache, tool calls, and agent architectures.

items.title: @ScottPresler: Congressional Vote on Insider Trading
items.body: Scott Presler criticizes Congressional Democrats for voting against a proposed ban on insider stock trading, sparking debate on political wealth and legislative reform.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: BitMEX Exchange Shutdown
items.body: Prominent cryptocurrency exchange BitMEX has announced that it will shut down all operations, marking a major exit in the crypto trading space.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: SpaceX SPCX Hits Post-IPO Low
items.body: SpaceX's stock (traded under the ticker SPCX) hit a new low since its initial public offering, dropping below $115 per share.

items.title: @APompliano: Continuing Market Bull Run
items.body: Anthony Pompliano highlights bullish macroeconomic data suggesting that the current market rally is set to persist for the foreseeable future.

items.title: @Oxzenith_zn: Nasdaq Dollar-Cost Averaging vs Education
items.body: Li Li humorously compares investing 100 RMB daily in the Nasdaq index over 16 years of schooling to seeking higher education, noting that the former would have resulted in financial freedom.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: FIFA 2026 World Cup Best XI
items.body: Fabrizio Romano shares the official Best XI squad released by FIFA for the 2026 World Cup, inviting fans to share their opinions and suggested changes.

items.title: @ESPNFC: Sergio Ramos Celebrates with World Cup Trophies
items.body: Sergio Ramos went viral after recreating Lionel Messi's iconic photo bedded with the World Cup trophy, except Ramos posed with two World Cup trophies in hand.

items.title: @vxunderground: Bryan Johnson Fetal Cloning Controversy
items.body: vx-underground reports on anti-aging influencer Bryan Johnson's claims that scientists cloned him to create a fetus in a petri dish, aiming to harvest organs and conduct experiments on it in the future.

items.title: @Phoenixyin13: Nash Equilibrium and Fixed-Point Theorem
items.body: Phoenix Yin writes a detailed thread explaining John Nash's mathematical intuition, describing how he bypassed complex algebraic proofs by using Kakutani and Brouwer fixed-point theorems to prove the Nash Equilibrium in just two pages.

items.title: @twin_abena: Michael Olise Courting Kylian Mbappé
items.body: Reports suggest Bayern Munich winger Michael Olise has been actively courting Kylian Mbappé to join him at Bayern Munich, explaining their pitch harmony and Munich lifestyle.
